stem: A frequency distribution has class marks 15, 25, 35, 45, 55 with frequencies 8, 12, 15, 10, 5 respectively. Using an assumed mean of 15 and the deviations d = x - 15, a student finds Sigma f*d = 920 and Sigma f*d^2 = 24200 over N = 50. What is the coefficient of variation of the distribution (to two decimals)?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Omits the correction term: takes variance = Sigma f*d^2 / N = 24200/50 = 484, so SD = 22 and CV = 22/33.4*100 = 65.87%. The deviations are measured from 15, not from the mean, so (Sigma f*d / N)^2 must be subtracted.
Divides the corrected sum of squares by N-1 = 49 instead of N = 50, using the sample formula on a full distribution: SD = sqrt((24200 - 920^2/50)/49) = 12.12, CV = 36.47%.
Reports the SD value 12.06 as if it were a percentage and stops, never dividing by the mean to form the coefficient of variation.

explanation: With deviations taken from an assumed mean A = 15, the variance is Sigma f*d^2 / N minus the correction (Sigma f*d / N)^2. Mean = 15 + 920/50 = 33.4; variance = 484 - 338.56 = 145.44; SD = 12.06; CV = SD/mean*100 = 36.11%. Dropping the correction term inflates the SD to 22 and the CV to 65.87%, which is the central trap.

explanation_sections.punchline: The deviations are measured from the assumed mean 15, not the true mean, so the variance carries a correction term: var = Sigma f*d^2 / N - (Sigma f*d / N)^2 = 484 - 338.56 = 145.44, never the bare 484.
explanation_sections.approach: Model: assumed-mean (shortcut) variance, then CV = SD/mean*100. Assumption: deviations d = x - A with A = 15, so A is offset from the mean and the offset must be removed. Recipe in five steps. (1) Mean = A + Sigma f*d / N = 15 + 920/50 = 33.4. (2) Raw second moment about A = Sigma f*d^2 / N = 24200/50 = 484. (3) Correction = (Sigma f*d / N)^2 = (18.4)^2 = 338.56. (4) Variance = 484 - 338.56 = 145.44, SD = 12.06. (5) CV = 12.06/33.4*100 = 36.11%.
explanation_sections.lesson: When deviations are taken from an assumed mean rather than the actual mean, always subtract (Sigma f*d / N)^2 from Sigma f*d^2 / N before taking the square root.
explanation_sections.timing: About 130 seconds: one mean, one second moment, one correction, one root, one ratio. Eliminate 65.87% immediately as the no-correction trap, and reject 12.06% on sight because it is the SD reported without dividing by the mean.
